# Acceptance tests, Campaign

Tests for the Campaign steps, in build order. Form and pass rule: [Acceptance tests](acceptance.md).

## Incident archive

- **ARCHIVE-01**: Setup: new game, the opening misfire's report closed; order 1 Signing ceremony open on its opening wiring; HandResults. Do: cut the wire from the input terminal, run, close the report; run the same wiring again, close the report. Open the archive after each. Expect: [ARCHIVE-01](../campaign/incident-archive.md#archive-01-file).
- **ARCHIVE-02**: Setup: a save with every order of act 1 won, so order 6 Latin hour is unlocked with no report and no result; order 5 Museum split won by two different wirings; order 1 Signing ceremony filed in this order: the opening misfire's report, one led by its result stopped at IN, one led by its result stopped at LAMINATOR, its mission report; HandResults. Do: open ARCHIVE from the order list; tap act 1's heading. Expect: [ARCHIVE-02](../campaign/incident-archive.md#archive-02-browse).
- **ARCHIVE-03**: Setup: order 1 Signing ceremony holds a filed report; the archive open. Do: tap that report's row. Expect: [ARCHIVE-03](../campaign/incident-archive.md#archive-03-reprint).

## Campaign

- **CAMPAIGN-01**: Setup: new game, no order won, no result found; OpeningGuard. Do: flip the AUDIO switch off and on; tap anywhere else; tap again inside OpeningGuard; tap again after it; in a second new game, tap again only once the full alarm lights; close the report; close act 1's memo; read order 1's board. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-01](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-01-opening-misfire).
- **CAMPAIGN-02**: Setup: orders 1 Signing ceremony to 3 Diplomatic pouch won; Acts; OrdersPerAct. Do: win order 4 Archive day; win order 5 Museum split; win order 1 again. Read the teletype and the order list after each. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-02](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-02-unlock). **Derived:** the first win of order act number × OrdersPerAct unlocks the first order of the next act.
- **CAMPAIGN-03**: Setup: every order of act 1 won, order 6 Latin hour unlocked, act 2's memo never closed. Do: open order 6 and read the memo; close the game with it open, reopen it, open order 6 again; close the memo; open order 6 once more; tap act 2's heading. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-03](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-03-act-start).
- **CAMPAIGN-04**: Setup: every order of act 1 won but order 5 Museum split; one hand-written result of act 1 found; Acts; OrdersPerAct; HandResults. Do: win order 5, close the report; close the game with the debrief on the teletype, reopen it; close the debrief; in the archive tap act 1's heading. Then, from a save with every order won but order 30 Final launch, win order 30. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-04](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-04-act-end). **Derived:** the debrief follows the first win of order act number × OrdersPerAct; an unearned results line counts found of HandResults × OrdersPerAct; after act Acts no order follows.
- **CAMPAIGN-05**: Setup: a save that is not new: every order of act 1 won, order 5 Museum split won by two different wirings, order 4 Archive day's pars met, order 6 Latin hour unlocked; HandResults. Do: close the game, reopen it; open order 3 Diplomatic pouch; return with ORDERS; tap order 6. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-05](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-05-order-list).
- **CAMPAIGN-06**: Setup: orders 1 Signing ceremony to 4 Archive day won; second-wiring lamps of orders 3 and 4 lit; order 4's WirePar and TimePar met; every hand-written result of act 1 found but the last of order 5 Museum split; order 5 unwon, its lamp dark. Do: run order 5 on a wiring that gives the missing result; win order 5 with INSPECTOR before each LAMINATOR, close the report; win it again the same way; win it with LAMINATOR before INSPECTOR. Read the teletype after each report. Expect: [CAMPAIGN-06](../campaign/campaign.md#campaign-06-after-the-report).

## Achievements

- **ACHIEVE-01**: Setup: every order of act 1 won, second-wiring lamps of orders 3 and 4 lit, order 4's WirePar and TimePar met; order 5 Museum split won once with INSPECTOR before each LAMINATOR, its lamp dark, its WirePar unmet; every hand-written result of act 1 found but the last of order 5; HandResults; OrdersPerAct. Do: run order 5 on a wiring that gives the missing result; win order 5 with LAMINATOR before INSPECTOR; win it once more. Read the teletype after each report. Expect: [ACHIEVE-01](../campaign/achievements.md#achieve-01-earn). **Derived:** the results kind needs HandResults × OrdersPerAct finds in an act; each of the Acts holds three kinds.
- **ACHIEVE-02**: Setup: two browsers. The second lacks the last hand-written result of act 1 and holds part of the results of acts 2 and 3; the first holds the rest of those results and carries Under Budget; neither holds Line Noise or Kitchen Incidents. Do: in the second, run the wiring that gives the missing result of order 5 Museum split and read the teletype; copy the first browser's save code; in the second, tap LOAD SAVE CODE, paste, tap READ; read the teletype; read the same code again; open the archive. Expect: [ACHIEVE-02](../campaign/achievements.md#achieve-02-show). **Derived:** the archive lists three achievements per act, three × Acts in all.

## Report sharing

- **SHARE-01**: Setup: a printed report of order 1 Signing ceremony with its share control; GameLink. Do: tap the share control, then TEXT; paste the clipboard into a text field. Repeat in a browser that refuses the clipboard write, and on a device with a share sheet. Expect: [SHARE-01](../campaign/report-sharing.md#share-01-text).
- **SHARE-02**: Setup: filed reports of order 1 Signing ceremony led by its result stopped at LAMINATOR, of order 2 Victory parade led by its result lost, of order 9 Colony bulletin wired IN → TRANSLATOR; TRANSLATOR → LAMINATOR 1; LAMINATOR 1 → CENSOR; CENSOR plus → SUMMARIZER; SUMMARIZER → LAMINATOR 2; LAMINATOR 2 → TRANSLATOR, led by no hand-written result, and a mission report; PictureWidth; PictureHeight; QRSize; GameLink; PictureTextRows; PictureDrawingMin; the device offline. Do: for each report tap the share control, then PICTURE; open the saved file. Repeat in a browser whose links lack the download attribute; there, tap the AUDIO switch, then the picture. Repeat on a device that shares files. Expect: [SHARE-02](../campaign/report-sharing.md#share-02-picture). **Derived:** the file measures PictureWidth by PictureHeight; the QR code is QRSize across; order 9's lead takes PictureTextRows rows, its last ending "…", and prints once; its drawing is PictureDrawingMin high or more.
